{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the 'revenue' column to inspect formatting
print("First few revenue values (raw):")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for any rows with '999999.99' — but also check if it might be '999,999.99' due to Excel export
print("\nAny revenue values equal to '999999.99'?")
print(sales['revenue'].eq('999999.99').sum())

print("\nAny revenue values equal to '999,999.99'? (likely the actual QA format)")
print(sales['revenue'].eq('999,999.99').sum())

# Show the actual values that match this pattern
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print("\nSample of QA rows:")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'status']].head())"}
